metadata.title: PSWinUtil
metadata.description:
PSWinUtil is a PowerShell module for Windows users. Dependencies are automatically installed by Scoop and Chocolatey. It contains the following functions.

- Set Windows by rewriting the registry
- Instantly find file and folder paths
- Get media file properties such as videos and photos
- Get and change monitor resolution and refresh rate
- Add or remove paths for path environment variables

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Set-WUWindowsAutoLogin' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
